title: Use an owned readiness phase for the macOS live-group cleanup control
outcome: bounded_read_cleanup_native_live_group_control_is_killed_and_reaped verifies a ready live process group is killed/reaped without requiring shell startup and pipe delivery within two seconds.
acceptance: The test observes and owns the ready live-child phase before cleanup; exact ready line, SIGKILL and reaped assertions remain.
The test uses the established fixture-phase/deadlock guard contract rather than a two-second startup success window, without changing production cleanup budgets, adding retry, or ignoring the test.
